name: Use Case Diagram
description: Use Case Diagram describes external actors and the functional goals they want to achieve when interacting with the system. This diagram helps define the scope of requirements and system boundaries.
purpose: Define scope of requirements and system boundaries at a high-level for stakeholders.
bestFor: Define scope between customer and development team
Basis for writing user stories or test cases
Describe system functionality for non-technical stakeholders
notSuitableFor: Describe detailed step-by-step processing flow → use Activity / Sequence Diagram
Describe class/entity structure → use Class Diagram
Describe object lifecycle states → use State Machine Diagram
useCases: Identify actors: users, departments, external systems
Identify use cases: goals actors want to achieve
Draw system boundary surrounding use cases
Add «include» — use case must call another use case

elements.name: Actor
elements.description: Users, departments or external systems that interact with the system

elements.name: Use Case
elements.description: Goal/function the actor wants to achieve

elements.name: System Boundary
elements.description: Scope of the system under consideration

elements.name: Include
elements.description: Use case that must call another use case

confusableWith.difference: Use Case describes what functions the system has; Activity describes how that function runs step by step.
Use Case is at requirements level; Sequence is at technical interaction level over time.
